# Recep Sen - Personal Portfolio

> CTO and software architect specializing in microservices, .NET, TypeScript, and
> AI-driven development. Currently leading technology at Taptoweb.
> Building products serving 250,000+ users.

## About

Recep Sen is a software engineer and CTO based in Turkey. Areas of expertise include
microservices architecture, C# and .NET ecosystems, TypeScript, system design, DevOps,
and AI development tooling. He designed a 28-service microservices platform powering
Easyapp.ai, a no-code mobile app builder with 250,000+ users.
